reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), during AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(d.units, 0) AS promo_units, COALESCE(d.revenue, 0) AS promo_revenue
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id

solver.query:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT promo_id, promo_type, discount_pct, start_date, end_date, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), dur AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS margin, SUM(ol.line_discount_eur) AS disc
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), base AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.units) AS units, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS rev,
         SUM(s.net_revenue_eur - s.units * s.unit_cost_eur) AS margin
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - (14) AND p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), t AS (
  SELECT p.*, COALESCE(d.units,0) AS pu, COALESCE(b.units,0) AS bu,
         COALESCE(d.rev,0) AS pr, COALESCE(b.rev,0) AS br,
         COALESCE(d.margin,0) AS pm, COALESCE(b.margin,0) AS bm, COALESCE(d.disc,0) AS disc
  FROM promo p
  LEFT JOIN dur d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id
  LEFT JOIN base b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id
)
SELECT promo_id, pu AS promo_units, pr AS promo_revenue FROM t
